svg.title: Pinecrest Works exterior painting portfolio concept
svg.desc: Fictional painting portfolio concept for Pinecrest Works, showing newly refreshed residential exterior siding and porch. Purpose-built demonstration visual for LocalPro Directory; it does not depict a real business, credential, review or completed client project.
